bio.text: Chris Harden is the Democratic nominee for Georgia's 11th Congressional District in 2026, after winning the May 19 primary over Barry Wolfert.
He was born in Rossville, Georgia, and earned a bachelor's degree from Georgia State University in 2009 and a law degree from John Marshall Law School in 2012.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and business owner.

sources.title: Chris Harden wins Democratic U.S. District 11 primary
